soru: how many characters shall a subscriber-chosen memorized secret be at least
cevap: A subscriber-chosen memorized secret shall be at least 8 characters in length. (~ #pdf:nist_sp800-63b.pdf)

soru: what length of memorized secret should verifiers permit
cevap: Verifiers should permit subscriber-chosen memorized secrets to be at least 64 characters in length. (~ #pdf:nist_sp800-63b.pdf)

soru: how often should reauthentication be repeated at AAL1
